messages:
Priya: Quick thread to agree on a Model Family Split policy. Problem: when a model family diverges (e.g., model-v2 changes tokenizer/response format), customers need a clear opt-in path for migrations. Proposal: define 'family-split guardrails' + a compat-shim option + soft-pin economic tiers. Looking for ops, legal, and sales input.

Ravi: Ops constraints: compat-shim only works if runtime supports both tokenizers/kernels. If not, treat as a breaking change and require explicit migration windows. Suggest a canary cadence: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 24-72h with a 72h hold for high-risk tenants.

Jun: Bench gating ideas: measure embed drift (cosine delta), end-to-end task score delta (task-specific), and latency p95. Concrete thresholds could be: embed cosine drift <= 0.025, task-score drop <= 0.02, p95 delta <= +20ms. We'll productize these as named checks.

Lina: From product: customers will want a label for 'breaking semantics' vs 'backwards compatible'. We should surface that in the catalog UI and in AE materials. Also add a toggle per-tenant to allow 'compat shim' vs 'strict pin'.

Sam: Commercial: propose three tiers: Standard (no pin, 7d notice), Soft-Pin (30/60d paid), Full-Pin (90d + SLA). For breaking changes, require signed migration plan and credits if we fail to rollback within agreed SLA.

LegalBot: Note: we need precise definitions for "customer-reported regression" and the metric-based triggers. I'll draft clause language that maps to the named checks Jun mentioned. Need to loop in procurement for pin fees.

CanaryBot: info: canary job scheduled for test-farm; harness will emit drift & score reports to /canary-reports.

Priya: Good alignment. Open questions: 1) Do we allow quantized-only variants as part of same family or separate SKU? 2) How to present compatibility in the model catalog (UI copy + API fields). 3) Owner for per-tenant override flags.

Ravi: Quantized-only = separate SKU unless runtime guarantees bitwise equivalence. Per-tenant flags should live in Config Service; I'll own the ops implementation.

Jun: I'll extend the bench harness to label checks with severity and output a single pass/fail. Will add sample prompts for retrieval/chat/embed slices.

Lina: I'll draft catalog UI copy that clearly tags breaking vs compatible, and include an inline "request migration" flow for AEs.

Sam: I'll add pricing tiers draft and AE FAQ.

Priya: Action items: Jun bench spec by Thu, Lina UI copy by Fri, Ravi to scope per-tenant flag work by next week, Legal to draft contract mapping. RFC next Tue. Drop any edge cases here. :thumbsup:
